title: Riot Squad Fresh Leaf Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Riot Squad’s Fresh Leaf Nic Salt E-Liquid offers a genuinely fresh take on a classic vape flavour. Riot Squad have taken the timeless taste of traditional tobacco and added a beguiling background note of smooth dark chocolate – sweet and bitter in all the right places, but bolstered by that rich, robust tobacco flavour at its centre. For vapers and former smokers seeking a familiar yet endlessly satisfying flavour with a uniquely sweet twist, Riot’s Fresh Leaf might just be what they’ve been looking for. Riot Squad’s Riot Salt E-Liquids are formulated with Hybrid Nicotine, an innovative blend of traditional freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and nicotine salt and 50/50 PG and VG ratio provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit and one of the most realistic alternatives to traditional tobacco products.
